Delhi

Highly-detailed map of India's National Capital Region: Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, and Faridabad sprawling across the Yamuna plain, where Mughal-era monuments stand a few kilometers from one of the world's largest metro networks.

Additional Features

  • Building Collision: A buildings index is included, providing in-game collision geometry for all non-filtered buildings. Buildings have foundations ranging from -10 m to -80 m, calculated based on the building's height and footprint; the in-game foundations map layer visualizes these.
  • Water Depths: A water depth index is included, preventing tracks from being placed within the water. GEBCO bathymetric data are used where available, and a flat -5 m depth is assumed everywhere else; the in-game ocean foundations map layer visualizes these.
  • Place Labels: The map includes city, suburb, and neighborhood labels extracted from selected OSM place tags.

Methodology

Population: WorldPop 100m gridded raster.

Employment: OSM landuse, scaled to SHRUG/Economic Census (2013) totals.

Base commute pairs: doubly-constrained gravity model, decay exponent calibrated against Census 2011 Table B-28 distance-band data for NCT Delhi.

Special demand: Indira Gandhi International Airport (capacity from 2025 annual passenger throughput), plus IIT Delhi, Jawaharlal Nehru University, and Jamia Millia Islamia, each using that institution's own officially reported enrollment.

Consolidation: nearby low-volume commute flows spatially merged within a tiered distance threshold to keep total population count performant in-game, while preserving the variety of distinct commute destinations per origin point.

Routing and consolidation tooling: Depot.
